name: trackbridge
description: TrackBridge — AI-Driven Integrated Web Platform for CBTP Tracking, Internship Coordination, and Technical Project Management

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ai,web -c teal,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "bash -lc 'cd ai-service && python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000'" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
